bio: I'm Christian, a creative who grew up on the ice. Years as a hockey player and referee taught me to read a play before it happens and that instinct now shapes how I build visual stories. I bring that same read to design and athlete-focused content, no generative AI involved. Every frame is made by hand, keeping my carbon footprint small and my work distinct in an increasingly AI-saturated market.
Currently, I'm creating content for professional athlete MacKonner Dy and the BCHL officiating team.
